headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 14, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins secured a thrilling 7-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Dylan Beavers leading the Orioles' offense. Yaramil Hiraldo impressed on the mound with 1.2 scoreless innings. In other action, the St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies 7-1, while the Tampa Bay Rays secured an 8-4 victory over the Athletics.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Matt Chapman (abdominal strain) and Trevor McDonald (right elbow strain) of the San Francisco Giants, Garrett Whitlock (right elbow inflammation) of the Boston Red Sox, James Outman (concussion) and Riley Greene (right hamstring strain) of the Detroit Tigers, Endy Rodríguez (left hip inflammation) of the Pittsburgh Pirates, and Jake Bloss (no details) of the Toronto Blue Jays.

The Baltimore Orioles acquired Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox, while the Kansas City Royals traded for Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics received Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Brandan Bidois, Brian Sanchez, and Hyun Seung Lee.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles in Thrilling 7-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 5-7 win over the Baltimore Orioles, with Dylan Beavers leading the Orioles' offense with 1 hit, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Yaramil Hiraldo impressed on the mound with 1.2 scoreless innings, 3 strikeouts, and no walks.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Phillies 7-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies, securing a 7-1 victory. Alec Burleson led the Phillies' offense with 2 hits and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Athletics 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured an 8-4 victory over the Athletics, with Liam Hicks leading the charge at the plate. Hicks finished with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs in 5 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Rockies Take Down Diamondbacks 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies secured a 6-4 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with Ryan Feltner earning the win. Brett Sullivan led the Rockies' offense with a home run, three RBIs, and a 1-for-4 batting line.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Impact players for the Tigers included Riley Greene, James Outman, and Spencer Torkelson, while Parker Messick had a standout performance on the mound.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past White Sox 9-8**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a thrilling 9-8 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with multiple players contributing to the win. Impact hitters for the Reds included Sal Stewart, Tyler Stephenson, Eugenio Suárez, Chase Meidroth, Randal Grichuk, Edgar Quero, and Sam Antonacci.

top_news.title: **Matt Chapman Shifts to 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants third baseman Matt Chapman has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to an abdominal strain.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
